topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture series and outlines the core concepts and learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages to clonal cell populations.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchy and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess how normal tissue stem cell hierarchies and the differentiation state of the cell of origin influence tumor initiation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Stromal Promotion of Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how microenvironmental cues, inflammatory signals, and stromal interactions provide essential permissive conditions for tumor initiation, progression, and maintenance.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Tumor Heterogeneity
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the single-cell and spatial omics technologies used to resolve the evolutionary history and cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Synthesis of Multifactorial Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors integrate to drive cancer development through Darwinian evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
